svg.aria-label: Parts of the violin seen from the front, parts of the bow, and where each right-hand finger touches the bow in the bow hold
svg.text: Parts of the violin and the bow hold
The names teachers use, and where each finger of the right hand sits on the bow.
G D A E, left to right
Inside, not visible: soundpost and bass bar (don't touch).
The shoulder rest clips onto the back.
Bow hold: close-up of the frog end
on the side of the frog
All fingers curved, never locked straight.
Practise the hold on a pencil first.
Loosen the hair after every session.
Based on Chapters 3 and 5 of this post. Drawing not to scale.
